paragraphs.en: We {all} want it … to accept and love ourselves.But at times it seems too difficult and too {far} out of reach.Where do you start? Here's a {handful} of ways that will set you in the right {direction} .
paragraphs.cn: 我们 <u> 都 </u> 想……接纳并爱自己。但有时这似乎太难，太 <u> 遥 </u> 不可及了。要从哪里开始呢？这里有 <u> 几个 </u> 方法，可以让你朝着正确的 <u> 方向 </u> 前进。

paragraphs.en: Stop {comparing} yourself with {others} .Sometimes we are {bound} by society's expectations, which make us feel like being in a constant {contest} with others.Do not {follow} the people who make you feel not-good-enough.Are you hoping that eventually you will feel {empowered} because your life is better than theirs? Don't feel guilty if you are {fond} of yourself; embrace your personal traits instead. {Roses} bloom ( (开花) ) in their own time.Maybe you have a {slim} figure or a {beard} , and perhaps you love to wear a {pink} {blouse} and skinny ( (紧身的) ) {jeans} .You might not be conventionally pretty or {handsome} , but these traits are what make us who we are.
paragraphs.cn: 停止拿自己与 <u> 他人比较 </u> 。有时，我们被社会的期望所 <u> 束缚 </u> ，这让我们感觉自己在与他人进行一场永无休止的 <u> 竞争 </u> 。不要 <u> 追随 </u> 那些让你觉得自己不够好的人。你是不是希望最终有一天你的生活比他们好，从而让你感到 <u> 有力量 </u> ？如果你 <u> 喜欢 </u> 自己，不要感到内疚，而是要接受自己的个性特征。 <u> 玫瑰 </u> 自有花期。也许你身材 <u> 苗条 </u> ，或留着 <u> 胡子 </u> ，也许你喜欢穿 <u> 粉红色的衬衫 </u> 和紧身 <u> 牛仔裤 </u> 。你可能不是传统意义上的漂亮或 <u> 英俊 </u> ，但正是这些特征造就了独特的我们。

paragraphs.en: {Forgive} yourself for {mistakes} and be kind to yourself.We are often {ashamed} of our {shortcomings} , our mistakes and our {failures} . {Remember} , you are an ordinary {human} who {sneezes} in cold weather and gets {toothache} at times. {Rather} than getting {caught} up in how you could have done better, why not {offer} yourself a {compassionate} response?“That didn't go as {planned} .But, I tried my best.”
paragraphs.cn: <u> 原谅 </u> 自己的 <u> 错误 </u> ，善待自己。我们常常因自己的 <u> 缺点 </u> 、错误和 <u> 失败 </u> 而感到 <u> 羞愧 </u> 。 <u> 记住 </u> ，你就是个普通 <u> 人 </u> ，会在天冷时 <u> 打喷嚏 </u> ，有时也会 <u> 牙疼 </u> 。 <u> 与其纠结 </u> 于自己本来怎样可以做得更好，为什么不 <u> 给 </u> 自己一个 <u> 富有同情心的 </u> 回应呢？“事情没有按 <u> 计划 </u> 进行。但是，我已经尽了最大的努力。”

paragraphs.en: {Recognize} all of your strengths.Write them down in a {journal} . {Begin} to {train} your brain to look at strength before {weakness} .Then you'll know what goals are achievable, such as adding more vegetables into your {menu} or learning to {ski} . {List} all of your {accomplishments} and {achievements} .You have a {job} , {earned} your {degree} , and you got out of {bed} today.There's no need to wait for {super} achievements to start to {celebrate} .
paragraphs.cn: <u> 认清 </u> 自己所有的优点。把它们写在 <u> 日记 </u> 里。 <u> 开始训练 </u> 你的大脑，先看优点，再看 <u> 缺点 </u> 。然后你会知道哪些目标是可以实现的，比如在 <u> 菜单 </u> 中增加更多蔬菜或学习 <u> 滑雪 </u> 。 <u> 列出 </u> 你所有的 <u> 成就 </u> 和 <u> 成绩 </u> 。你有 <u> 工作 </u> ， <u> 获得 </u> 了 <u> 学位 </u> ，今天你又从 <u> 床 </u> 上起来了。没有必要等到取得 <u> 极好的 </u> 成就时才开始 <u> 庆祝 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Now that you've listed your strengths, list your {imperfections} .Turn the page in your journal.Put into words why you feel {unworthy} , why you don't feel good enough.Now, read these words back to yourself.Feeling {upset} again? Turn to a page in your journal with your list of strengths and achievements.See how {awesome} you are?
